 About the festival
 La Bodega Live 2027 takes place on Saturday 26 June 2027 at Bodegas Franco-Españolas in Logroño . It is the second edition of a one-day festival that turns the winery's gardens and vineyards into a stage, with Siloé as the first confirmed name and more artists to be announced.
 La Bodega Live 2027 line-up
 So far the festival has confirmed Siloé , the band from Valladolid who arrive on the tour for «Terrorismo emocional», their 2026 album, and who are also playing other festivals in summer 2027, as we cover in where to see Siloé in 2027 . The official website says more artists are still to be confirmed. The announcement, with tickets and the rest of Siloé's tour, is in our news story on La Bodega Live 2027 .
 Tickets and prices
 Tickets are sold only through the festival's official shop . The launch offer, at €55 including fees, has sold out; first-tier general admission costs €60.50 , including €5.50 in booking fees. The shop does not say when the price will change. Children aged up to 10 get in free.
 Times and venue
 Doors open at 19:00 and the programme starts at 20:00 . The festival takes place at Bodegas Franco-Españolas, at calle Cabo Noval, 2, in Logroño, among gardens, vineyards and barrels. The rest of that month's events are in the June festival calendar .
 How the first edition went, in 2026
 La Bodega Live made its debut on 27 June 2026 with Shinova , Gara Durán and Ultraligera . According to the La Rioja press, it sold out its 4,500 tickets before the doors opened. Logroño also hosts Festival Actual and MUWI .
 Sources: La Bodega Live's official website and ticket shop, consulted on 13 November 2026; CrazyMinds and Actualidad Rioja Baja (12 November 2026).
